description: Converts text to a case (upper, lower, sentence, title, capitalize, inverse, alternating, camel, pascal, snake, constant, kebab, dot) or cleans it up (trim spaces, collapse blank lines, join lines, unwrap lines broken by PDF copies, straight quotes, sort, dedupe or reverse lines). Locale-aware (Turkish i, Romanian ș).

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

lang.description: BCP 47 language for case rules, e.g. "tr", "ro" (default en)

output.description: Write the result to this file instead of returning it

name: text_case
title: Change case and clean up text
